authority_invariant: Capability is not authority. Discovery is not permission. Connection is not permission. Participation is not authorization.

participation_tiers.description: Read, clone, run verification, inspect claims, submit bounded issues or pull requests, and challenge authority boundaries through GitHub.
Exercise the constrained machine-principal, discovery, ingress, and receipt paths through repository test fixtures on contributor-owned local or disposable infrastructure.

Run a configured constrained machine principal through the supported local authority path when it has a configured human sponsor and finite action, purpose, destination, runtime, lifetime, and budget ceilings.
Portable external agent identity, currentness, handoff, and independently verifiable work receipts without relying on one local bearer-token registry.
blockers: portable machine identity is not promoted in the supported build
global or independently retained currentness is not promoted
no public MCP/A2A execution endpoint is promoted
no general external-agent executor is promoted

participation_tiers.description: Participate in plural project governance through separately evidenced mandates without acquiring ambient repository or runtime authority.
blockers: plural authority remains roadmap work rather than a production-promoted repository-governance path
machine principals cannot self-sponsor or self-delegate
GitHub remains the canonical repository authority surface
merge, deployment, credential, spending, and production-promotion authority remain separately gated

security_work_available_now: run the protected-equivalent local verification surface
exercise machine-principal and machine-discovery adversarial tests
review the current threat model against implementation
select a bounded RED-TEAM-TARGETS.json target and submit a reproducible finding
propose patches through normal pull requests
submit hardware, infrastructure, compatibility, benchmark, and claim-audit evidence through bounded contribution lanes

safe_to_automate_without_operator_effect: static analysis and bounded security review
separate_explicit_authority_required: spending, reimbursement, purchasing, or paid services
shipping, custody, or transfer of hardware
testing third-party systems without explicit authorization

future_governance_direction.goal: reduce operator bottlenecks through plural, evidence-bound authority rather than by removing authority checks
must_preserve: separation of identity, capability, authority, consent, evidence, and legitimacy
no self-granting authority by models, agents, adapters, or governance automation

nonclaims: This manifest does not create a public AXIOM-MESH runtime or remote executor.
GitHub participation, Agent Community membership, a certificate, a signed artifact, or a successful test does not grant AXIOM-MESH authority.
Local conformance proves only the tested repository behavior and environment.
The supported build does not yet provide autonomous community governance or a human-free production authority root.
